The extracted code only accounts for about 10–12 points (the nested `if`/`else`, the inner `if` with its `||` chain, the handler `if`, and the `||` sequences in `guarded`), and the new `if (ExpressRoute(...) is { } route)` adds back 2–3, so `ExpressAndFastify` likely ends up around 18–20, still above 15.
